page.overview:
Who is Doug RM?

"Larry and Doug are the best of friends: these two can usually be found raising Cain and takin' names on Redneck Hill. But despite their rowdy nature they are true southern gentlemen, and dead serious when it comes to racing. They know the stats on every team, which is useful since they've always got a bet riding on who will be the next Piston Cup champion."

Doug and Larry can be seen among other caravans at the Motor Speedway of the South. While there, Doug says "You got that right, slick!" to Larry, and whistles. Later, they appear when Lightning McQueen spins onto the infield after he was hit by Chick Hicks. Doug whistles again as McQueen then gets back onto the track.

Doug and Larry also attend at the Los Angeles International Speedway, where they are seen next to Albert Hinkey. When the crowd notices Doc Hudson, Doug says to dip himself in axle grease and call him Slick. He later remarks on McQueen's heroic actions, calling it "racing out there" when the latter forfeits the win to help Strip Weathers finish his last race, much to the sadness of Albert Hinkey.
